task_summary: Parse a .Civ6Map SQLite file, compute hex adjacencies, and optimally place city centers and districts to maximize total adjacency bonuses for Civilization VI scenario 3.
decomposition_rationale: The task naturally decomposes into three concerns: (1) parsing the binary map format from SQLite, (2) encoding all Civ6 district adjacency rules and computing bonuses, and (3) orchestrating the search/optimization for optimal placements. Separating map I/O from game rules from optimization logic keeps each skill focused and testable.

skills.name: evo-civ6-map-parser
skills.description: Parses .Civ6Map SQLite database files to extract map dimensions, terrain, features, resources, and river edge data into Python data structures. Provides hex coordinate utilities (offset-to-cube conversion, neighbor enumeration) for the odd-r pointy-top hex grid used by Civ6.
skills.responsibility: All SQLite I/O, map data extraction (Plots, PlotRivers, PlotFeatures, PlotResources, MapAttributes), coordinate system math (odd-r offset to cube and back), and neighbor computation. Does NOT compute game rules or adjacency bonuses.
dr_sections: Part I: Hexagonal Grid Coordinate System in Civilization VI
Part II: The `.Civ6Map` Binary File Format Specification

skills.name: evo-civ6-adjacency-rules
skills.description: Encodes all Civilization VI Gathering Storm district adjacency bonus rules, placement validity checks, population-based district limits, and civilization-specific modifiers. Computes the adjacency bonus for any district placed at any tile given current map state and placed districts.
skills.responsibility: District placement validation (terrain restrictions, distance limits, resource blocking), population-to-district-slot calculation, complete adjacency bonus computation for all district types (Campus, Commercial Hub, Industrial Zone, Holy Site, Theater Square, Harbor, Aqueduct, etc.), civilization-specific overrides (Japan, Germany, Korea, Australia, Brazil, Netherlands, Mali), and minor bonus floor rounding.
dr_sections: Part III: District Placement and Population Rules
Part IV: Complete District Adjacency Bonus Rules

skills.name: evo-civ6-placement-optimizer
skills.description: Searches for optimal city center and district placements to maximize total adjacency bonuses given scenario constraints (num_cities, population, civilization). Reads scenario JSON, uses map parser and adjacency rules to evaluate candidates, and writes the solution JSON output.
skills.responsibility: Loading scenario configuration, enumerating candidate city center locations, enumerating valid district placement combinations within city working range (3 tiles), running optimization/search (brute force, greedy, or heuristic) to maximize total adjacency, handling multi-city scenarios, and writing the final output JSON in the required format.
dr_sections: Part III: District Placement and Population Rules
Part IV: Complete District Adjacency Bonus Rules
